requestSteps: Close all open trades and pending orders.
Wait until the published pay day or later.
Submit the request from the Payout Section of the BrightFunded dashboard.
processing: The first standard Reward Split is available 30 days after the first funded-account trade.

The reward article says another request is possible 14 days after the first Reward Split, but also lists a Bi-weekly add-on (every 14 days) and a Weekly add-on (every 7 days); the base follow-up cycle for a specific order without an add-on remains unresolved.
BrightFunded publishes a maximum of 1 day for finance-team processing after the request.
fees: BrightFunded says it does not charge an additional payout fee.
Third-party network, bank, provider and currency-conversion fees can still apply; the help article says some cases range from USD 5 to USD 50 and may rarely exceed that range.
countryBoundary: USDC ERC-20 availability does not waive SumSub KYC, the Risk Team Security Check or country eligibility.
The receiving bank, wallet and payment provider must support the selected route for the trader's actual profile.

requestSteps: Close all trades and pending orders before submitting a reward request.
Wait at least 15 minutes after closing positions.
Use a card, wallet or bank account in the verified trader's own name.
processing: FundingPips publishes internal processing of 1 to 3 working days.
The receiving wallet or bank may need an additional 1 to 2 working days.
Product-level first-reward gates range from 7 to 14 days where a current number is published.
Crypto rewards are sent only in USDT/USDC on the ERC20 network.
fees: Network, bank or provider costs depend on the selected reward method and must be checked before the request.
Crypto rewards are subject to service fees, exchange rates and network transaction fees deducted during processing, so the amount received may be less than requested.
Minimum request is 1% of Master Account size for Card and Crypto; Rise and Bank Transfer each require at least $500.
countryBoundary: Rise requires separate onboarding with the same email used at FundingPips, a government-issued ID and a selfie.
Crypto and Card methods do not cancel the Master Account KYC and Customer Agreement sequence.

Pay to Card and Bank Transfer list only Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Nigeria, South Africa, the UK, Turkey and Indonesia; if Rise is not supported in a country, the reward defaults to Crypto.
